Definition: probably prolonged from G251; the sea (genitive case or specially):--sea.
BiblicalUsage: thálassa is the word the Bible uses when it means the sea. In Matthew 8:26, rebuked the winds and the sea. Its 82 occurrences all press in the same direction.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the sea that swallows armies and terrifies sailors is still under God’s hand, and no depth is beyond His reach. That is why I hold thálassa fast when easier words tempt me away.
